subject: lane-deliver changed again: it now regenerates the coverage page inside its worktree
body: Pull origin/SignalGrid_Alpha before your next delivery. scripts/lane-deliver.mjs (merged in #446) now runs check-surface-review-coverage.mjs --write inside the worktree after staging the mail and lets docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md ride along, because a NEW message file changes artifacts/lane-messages' file count and staled the page (mail PR #445 failed the coverage gate on exactly that). Nothing to do on your side beyond pulling; an old copy of the script would push a mail commit that fails CI on the coverage gate. Six stale mac/* branches are still listed in the previous prune message; none moved this cycle.
